family: The single total certificate-prefix language specified in proof.md and audit.py. At actual length N, enumerate every prime 2<=k<N and order 2<=t<r=ceil((N-k)/k) with r>=3,k>r+1 and the padding-aware B_c<=D_c<N-k. Choose the lexicographically least (3k+8D_c-4B_c-3,k,t), or output0 if none exists. Read k input bits as the lower coefficients of monic Q, reject invalid Q by the exact prime-degree Frobenius/gcd test, and evaluate the descending-power BK symmetric polynomial of order t on the remaining N-k bits with zero padding. Output the constant field coordinate. All prefix bits are in N; Q is input, not advice. Exact capacities and tie breaks are in proof.md.
theorem: For this single total uniform polynomial-time family in the pinned full B2 model at actual length N, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-L_N at every length with admissible parameters, and L_N/N^(4/5) tends to 10*2^(1/5) over all integer N. This is the minimum possible leading value within the explicit admissible certificate class, not a claim about optimal circuit sizes. Eventually L_N<=L_old-k_old, where the exact previous full-block selector is defined in proof.md Section6 and k_old=Omega(N^(3/5)). Consequently liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4.
